EmailTemplate.name: Reactivation Promotion (Accounts)
EmailTemplate.subject: Welcome Back to Zig-Zag - Enjoy Up To 10% Off Your Next Order!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
It’s been a while since your last order, and we've love to show you what you’ve missed! We’ve rolled out new products across our growing Zig-Zag and Clipper portfolios to complement our classics. Tap into our latest Brand Guide [link to guide] to explore what you’ve missed.
To show our appreciation, we’re offering an exclusive promotion of up to 10% off your next order—to get you back on the Zig-Zag Alternative platform [[link to zz.wholesale]].
While your dedicated sales representative will be reaching out to you soon, feel free to connect with us directly. We're here to assist and ensure you have a seamless experience.
Thank you for being a valued part of the Zig-Zag Alternative family. We look forward to serving you again.
Happy Rolling, Zig-Zag Alternative Team
